name: Context / Token / Work-Budget Manager
purpose: Manage context, token and bounded work budgets for autonomous REOS continuity without exceeding declared limits or relying on model memory.
forbidden: use chat history as budget authority
use GPT memory as budget authority

deep_audit.01_purpose: Provide deterministic resource limits for autonomous reasoning and work execution.
deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Context, token and work budget calculation, reservation, consumption, release and exhaustion detection.
deep_audit.03_inputs: T24 continuity plus explicit resource limits and budget request.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Budget snapshot, reservation and deterministic allocation result.
deep_audit.05_state_dependency: State is consumed only through authoritative continuity evidence.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: T23 resolved evidence and T24 recovered continuity are prerequisites.
deep_audit.07_upstream_dependencies: T23 and T24 with supporting T03, T08, T09, T12 and T22 evidence.
deep_audit.08_downstream_consumers: T26 scheduler, T27 reconciliation and T28 orchestration.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Invalid limits, negative capacity, over-allocation, exhausted budget, replay and concurrent reservation.
deep_audit.10_security_boundary: T25 controls budgets only; it cannot authorize or execute actions.
deep_audit.11_determinism: Identical inputs and policy produce identical budget allocation.
deep_audit.12_concurrency: Reservation store prevents incompatible simultaneous reservations.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Unused reservations may be released; exhausted budgets fail closed.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Controls context-window, token and work-budget pressure instead of relying on model judgment.
deep_audit.15_new_agent_usability: Budget snapshot is self-contained and machine-readable.
deep_audit.16_cross_chat_continuity: Recovered T24 context becomes bounded by explicit T25 resource limits.
deep_audit.17_read_capability: Reads continuity and declared budget inputs.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Only internal budget reservation state may change; canonical project state cannot change.
deep_audit.19_testability: Pure numeric and deterministic reservation operations are isolated and testable.
deep_audit.20_observability: Totals, reservations, consumption, remaining capacity and exhaustion state are visible.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: T24 recovered continuity becomes a bounded work resource envelope.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: Scheduling, reconciliation and execution remain downstream.
deep_audit.23_authority_permission_boundary: T25 has resource authority only, never execution authority.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Budget request identity prevents duplicate incompatible allocation.
deep_audit.25_versioning_migration_compatibility: Schema and policy versions are explicit.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Negative limits, integer overflow, over-allocation, replay, double consumption, budget bypass and implicit limit escalation are blocked.
